original_ai_output.title_zh: 博茨瓦纳因批准猎杀大象供独立日庆典食用而遭批评
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 博茨瓦纳政府因批准在独立日庆典期间猎杀23头大象而受到动物权利活动人士的批评。据BBC报道，环境与旅游部发放许可证，授权在八个地区猎杀23头大象以提供庆典宴席用肉。该国于周三举行活动，纪念脱离英国独立60周年。

key_facts.fact: 博茨瓦纳政府因批准猎杀23头大象供独立日庆典食用而受到批评
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The government in Botswana has come under fire for authorising the killing of 23 elephants during its Independence Day celebrations.

key_facts.fact: 据BBC报道，环境与旅游部发放许可证，授权在八个地区猎杀23头大象以提供宴席用肉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to the BBC, the Ministry of Environment and Tourism issued a licence authorising the hunting of 23 elephants in eight districts to provide meat for feasting.

key_facts.fact: 博茨瓦纳周三举行活动，纪念脱离英国独立60周年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On Wednesday, the country marked the 60th anniversary of its independence from the United Kingdom with festive events held across the country.
